features: THE LINK THAT MOVES NOTHING — Two migrations: the database is modified. One adds two columns to «immobili» and removes a pivot table that was always empty; the other corrects the category of the «Ufficio» property type. The calculation engine is untouched: no amount changes in any document. A garage and the apartment it belongs to were two unrelated units, with nothing to say they are the same thing. From this version the link can be declared.

A PERTINENZA LINK CHANGES NO NUMBER. The research that preceded the work produced a result worth more than the feature itself: the link does not touch millesimal shares, allocation, balances or instalments. Not even quorums, which are counted per person and resolved on the register of owners (Italian Supreme Court, 2nd civil section, order 25558 of 12 November 2020). The «the garage should not pay for the stairs» case is not solved with pertinenze: it is solved with a restricted-scope table under art. 1123 paras. 2 and 3 of the Civil Code, which the software already supports. Below the field it says plainly that the link is descriptive and that the garage keeps its own shares, allocation and instalments.

A FOREIGN KEY, NOT THE MANY-TO-MANY TABLE THAT WAS ALREADY THERE. An «immobile_pertinenza» table with an ownership share had existed since 2025, and it was empty: no controller, no view, no test had ever touched it. It was not reused because many-to-many models something that cannot exist: art. 817 of the Civil Code requires both assets to have the same owner, and from that it follows that a pertinenza has exactly one principal asset. The «garage shared by two units» case is either co-ownership of the garage between two people, or a destination declared to a single unit, or a common asset under art. 1117 — which is not a pertinenza at all.

THE TOGNOLI CASE. Art. 9 para. 5 of Law 122/1989 allows a parking space to be sold only with simultaneous designation as a pertinenza of another unit located in the same municipality — which may be in another building, or not managed by the software. That is why the field has two alternative forms: the principal unit picked from a list when it is in this building, or written out in plain text when it is not. Without the second, the administrator would have left it blank, which is the opposite of the truth.

THE FIELD IS AVAILABLE ON EVERY UNIT, BY DESIGN. The software does not decide what can be a pertinenza: the recorded property type is a hint, not a fact, and an approximate classification must never make a feature unreachable. The classification is used where it does no harm: the «To be linked» filter suggests units of a pertinenza-like type with no declared link. In a building with 67 units it is the only way to see at a glance what is missing.

WHERE THE LINK IS VISIBLE. In the unit list every row carries its own state: «pertinenza of int. 3», «external unit» for the Tognoli case, a «+2 pertinenze» counter on units that have them, and «to be linked» in italics on a pertinenza-like unit that has not yet said whose it is. The unit record gains a «Pertinenze» tab, shown only when there is something to show. You cannot link or unlink from there: the field lives on the pertinenza's own record, because it is the pertinenza that declares whom it belongs to.

THE WARNING THAT DOES NOT BLOCK. If the garage and the apartment have different owners the software says so, and nothing more. Art. 817 requires the same owner, but the two situations that breach that requirement are both legitimate and common: the garage deed registered before the apartment's, and a separate sale that dissolved the link without anyone telling the administrator. Blocking would have prevented recording reality; staying silent would have suggested everything was fine.

THE BARE OWNER HAD THE COLOUR OF «I DON'T KNOW WHAT YOU ARE». The role-to-colour map was hand-written in three places in the interface and no two of them agreed. The role has been recordable since beta.43, and since then it travelled through half the software with the grey reserved for unknown values. The four roles now have a single colour from a single place, and the bare owner gets amber: on a unit with usufruct the law splits the costs — ordinary to the usufructuary (art. 1004), extraordinary to the bare owner (art. 1005) — and seeing it at a glance prevents charging the wrong person.

THE «UFFICIO» PROPERTY TYPE WAS CLASSIFIED AS RESIDENTIAL. The seeder declared four names twice, keyed on the name alone: the first declaration won. For «Negozio» both rows said the same thing. For «Magazzino» and «Deposito» they diverged, but the defensible reading won: a storage unit can legitimately be non-residential or an appurtenance, and which one it is depends on the individual case. For «Ufficio» it did not: «unita_abitativa» stayed, meaning an office recorded as a dwelling. A migration corrects it and the duplicates have been removed from the seeder. No calculation read that category, which is precisely why the error could survive.

WHAT THIS VERSION DOES NOT DO. The field is born without validity dates: art. 818 para. 3 makes the end of the link a fact with an enforceable date, so the dates will be needed — but they will arrive with the first calculation that reads them. There is no change-of-ownership operation, no history and no settlement: handling it here would have produced an operation that appears to manage succession by splitting the year in half, identical for a January deed and a December one. That belongs to 1.11.

WHAT THE REVIEW FOUND BEFORE RELEASE. Nine distinct findings: eight real defects, all fixed, and one that on verification was not a defect at all. The migration died on MySQL in the one partial state MySQL can produce, and from then on every later upgrade of that installation would have stopped at the same point. The one-level depth of the link was guarded on one side only, and the same rule looked at only one of the two columns. The filter was lost on the second page while the selector still declared it active. And the role badge, just unified, was unreadable in dark mode inside a panel that has no dark mode.
